tena kho pana samayena sunakkhatto licchaviputto acirapakkanto hoti imasmā dhammavinayā.
atha kho dummukho licchaviputto saccakaṃ nigaṇṭhaputtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ maṅkubhūtaṃ pattakkhandhaṃ adhomukhaṃ pajjhāyantaṃ appaṭibhānaṃ viditvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, upamā maṃ, bhagavā, paṭibhātī'ti.

atha kho, bhaggava, aññataro licchavimah'āmatto uṭṭhāy'āsanā taṃ parisaṃ etadavoca, tena hi, bho, muhuttaṃ tāva āgametha, yāv'āhaṃ gacchāmi. app'eva nāma aham'pi sakkuṇeyyaṃ acelaṃ pāthikaputtaṃ imaṃ parisaṃ ānetun'ti.
tena kho pana samayena pañcamattāni licchavisatāni santh'āgāre sannipatitāni honti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.

55839.commentary: (DNa) mahatiyā licchavīparisāyā'ti purebhattaṃ buddhappamukhassa bhikkhusaṅghassa dānaṃ datvā bhagavato santike uposath'aṅgāni adhiṭṭhahitvā gandhamāl'ādīni gāhāpetvā ugghosanāya mahatiṃ licchavirājaparisaṃ sannipātāpetvā tāya nīla-pīt'ādi-vaṇṇa-vatth'ābharaṇa-vilepana-paṭimaṇḍitāya tāvatiṃsaparisasappaṭibhāgāya mahatiyā licchaviparisāya saddhiṃ upasaṅkami.
